entities.name: Maxula-Radès church
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Maxula Radès church is an abandoned Catholic church in the city of Radès, Tunisia. It was built in 1911 during the French protectorate of Tunisia. The church was ceded to the Tunisian government in 1964 and has been abandoned ever since.
